title: Cringeworthy Lines
paragraphs: “Father, I’m back!”
I waved toward the window of the inn. Seeing this, Father and the others came rushing out to meet us.
“Welcome back… Whoa, they got huge!”
“Wait, you mean it hasn’t even been a full day since they hatched!?”
“I keep trying to tell myself this isn’t a game, but these guys are making a strong case that it is.”
Itsuki scratched his cheek, looking a bit sweaty. Father also seemed slightly exasperated.
“Guaa~”
Sakura-chan happily nuzzled against Father.
“Judging by the colors, this must be Sakura-chan. You’ve grown so much!”
“Isn’t this growth way too fast? Kitamura-dono, what level are they?”
“Level 40.”
“40!? They got to 40 in just a day!? That’s way too fast!”
“Hey, Motoyasu-kun, every time Sakura-chan moves, I hear this cracking noise. Is she okay? When I touch her, her muscles are wriggling…”
“No problem. This is just how Filolials grow.”
“She’s literally devouring all the meat in the cart with loud munching sounds…”
“Gua!”
After dropping off the cart, Yuki-chan suddenly dashed off.
“Where is she going!? Don’t tell me this is one of those ‘like owner, like pet’ situations!?”
Itsuki pointed at Yuki-chan as she ran off.
“Haha, Itsuki, you lack consideration for a lady’s needs. She’s just going to pick flowers.”
That’s exactly why stalker pigs are drawn to him. Well, considering what I saw in the first world, that stalker pig was actually quite competent.
“Truly an extraordinary creature.”
“Gua~”
“Sakura-chan, that tickles!”
A heartwarming scene between Father and Sakura-chan.
Oh? Looks like Kou is very interested in Itsuki. He’s sniffing him.
“Ugh… Please don’t eat me.”
“Are Filolials carnivores?”
“They’re omnivores.”
“Guaa!”
“Ahh! Stop that!”
Kou started licking Itsuki’s face. To be precise, he was gently gnawing on his hair.
“Ugh… now I’m all sticky.”
“Hmph.”
Ren, meanwhile, casually positioned himself near the entrance of the inn. Yuki-chan, having returned, stomped toward him and locked eyes.
A strange silence passed between Ren and Yuki-chan.
What’s going on?
“Ugh… I just want to take a bath already.”
“Come to think of it, you’ve barely stepped outside since you were being cautious. And this is a cheap inn, so there’s no bath.”
He’s drenched in sweat. When I think back to the real world, things like this really remind me we’re in another one.
“Shall we head to the bath, then?”
“Wait, shouldn’t we sort out Kitamura-dono’s souvenirs first?”
“Good point. Father, please accept these gifts.”
“Oh, uh… yeah.”

Father and the others loaded all the materials from my souvenir cart into their weapons. This should improve their equipment significantly. Well, considering their level requirements, they won’t be able to use them just yet.
“We’ve barely unlocked anything, though.”
“Yeah, fundamentally, our level just isn’t high enough.”
“Itsuki’s job level seems like it can go up, though. It looks like it’ll increase a lot, so isn’t that a good thing?”
“Yes, thank you very much.”
“Tch… Are you saying I still don’t have enough faith?”
“That sounds like something straight out of a middle school edgelord’s diary. Don’t worry, you’ll be able to do it soon… just believe.”
“Believe in everyone… I believe…”
As Father spoke, Ren muttered under his breath while Itsuki placed his hands on his hips, looking exasperated.
“The way you’re saying that, it sounds more like you’re just trying to convince yourself.”
“Shut up! I’m focusing on believing. Don’t interrupt me!”
Eventually, Ren’s expression brightened—looks like he unlocked a reinforcement option.
Can we consider this a success?
“I did it! It worked!”
“Yeah, nice job, Ren.”
“So, Kitamura-dono… I don’t think we should be attracting too much attention.”
Now that he mentioned it, I turned around to see a small crowd gathering in front of the inn. Their interest was clearly in the valuable goods loaded onto our cart.
“What’s this? This isn’t a show, I say. Let’s move.”
I released a bit of killing intent, and the ones with sharp instincts backed off.
Good. They know who’s on top here.
“Hah, what are you planning to do with all that treasure? Why don’t you lend it to us? We’ll make good use of it for you.”

A bunch of fools who think they can scam us were eyeing our loot with smug expressions. Truly idiotic. Even without considering strength, just a single word from Father, the Shield Hero, and these guys would be socially annihilated. But there’s no need to trouble Father over something this trivial.
“Oh? You want to fight?”
I pointed my spear at them, and, thinking they had a chance, they started to draw their weapons. Too slow. I swiftly knocked their weapons away and pressed my spear against their necks.
“Shall I paralyze you next?”
“Tch…”
Gritting their teeth in frustration, they scurried away. There are thugs in every country, after all.
“Let’s move a little. Get on the cart.”
“O-okay.”

Father and the others climbed onto the cart, and we left the capital of Siltvelt, stopping on a quiet road outside the city. Nocturnal beastmen and monsters soared through the night sky above us. After lighting a magical lamp, we began distributing our spoils.
“Even just looking from the window, I could tell—Siltvelt is really a country that never sleeps.”
“Even more so than Melromarc.”
“Yeah. Siltvelt is a demi-human nation. Since a lot of demi-humans and beastmen are nocturnal, they run their businesses at night, so the city never sleeps.”
“So it’s like a sleepless castle? There’s kind of a decadent atmosphere to it.”
“Naofumi-san, you secretly like places like this, don’t you?”
“Of course! I’m an otaku!”
Father seemed to be enjoying himself. Well, considering he had been holed up in the inn for almost two days, finally being outside again must have lifted his spirits.
“Where on earth did you get all this money…?”
“That would be from a hunting trip with Éclair, of course. We happened upon a dragon habitat, defeated the dragons, and took their treasure. What else?”
“You’re saying something outrageous as if it’s the most natural thing in the world!”
“Sounds like you hit the jackpot.”
“Looks like we can easily afford some top-tier equipment now.”
“Forget buying—look at these loot drops!”
“Looks like we’re about to get fully geared up.”

I pulled out a sword from the loot that looked like it would suit Éclair. Placing my hand on my spear… there. With a smooth motion, I materialized the sword from the spear. Ah, but first, I should let Ren have it.
“This is a Dragoneel Sword. Ren should hold onto it first.”

After copying it, I handed the sword to Éclair. Just like last time, she stared at it intently. Well, it’s far stronger than your average sword. Anyone who walks the path of a warrior would recognize its value.
“This is quite the fine blade. It almost feels too good for me… I’m not sure I can wield it properly.”
“You said the exact same thing last time.”
“Whoa… That sword looks amazing! Ren, I hope you’ll be able to use it too.”
“Yeah… This thing really is absurdly powerful.”
Ren stared at the sword in stunned silence.
“Next, we have armor.”
We’ll need at least five sets, including mine. Ah, but I’m already fully equipped with armor and other protective gear. It took a while to gather everything, though.
“We have Dragon Scale Mail, Bear Wild Armor, and all sorts of other gear.”
“Then lend me a full set.”
“Éclair should be able to equip this.”
I took out a Dragon Scale Armor set along with gauntlets, greaves, and boots.
“Ugh… It’s definitely heavy… but its performance is incredible. I have no choice but to master it.”
Éclair began putting on the armor.
“What about us?”
“Can you wear it right now, Father?”
For now, I took out a single set.
“Who wants to try it on first?”
Father and the others began discussing it among themselves. This is getting tedious—let’s just bring out two more sets.
“I can pull out more if needed, you know?”
“No, just trying them on should be fine…”
Father and the others tilted their heads as they tried to put on the armor.
“How exactly do you wear this? I figured out the breastplate, but…”
“If it were a chainmail, then maybe…”
“Here, I’ll help you put it on.”
I helped Ren, Itsuki, and Father into their armor. They all seemed to enjoy checking out each other’s new appearances, exchanging small smiles.
“Huh… It actually looks pretty good.”
Just as he said that, Father stepped down from the cart and immediately fell forward.
“Gwah!”
Sakura-chan grabbed him by the collar and lifted him up.
“Ah, thanks… It’s really heavy…”
“Same here…”
“I can’t move…”
Ren and Itsuki were also on the verge of collapsing.
“This must be one of those ‘not enough level’ situations.”
“Looks like it.”
“It looks so cool, but we can’t even wear it properly… That’s frustrating.”
“It’s tough for me too…”

Well, their stats are still pretty low. This equipment must have a minimum level requirement they don’t meet yet. That said… seeing Father in this fancy armor, I can’t help but feel that the armor he wore in his original world suited him best. Maybe that’s just my personal bias.
“So, what should we do with this armor? Where do we store it?”
“With the amount of money we have, we could rent a place long-term and use it as storage.”
“We’re heading toward Faubrey anyway… Should we leave it with an inn for safekeeping?”
“Yeah. Either way… I want to hit the baths first.”
“Before that, shouldn’t we at least level up Father and the others a little?”
“But it’s already nighttime. If we go out now, we might run into some nasty monsters.”
Éclair had a point, but we at least needed them to be able to walk around town. For that, they needed levels.
“Alright, Yuki-chan, Kou, Sakura-chan. Take Father and the others and level them up for two hours.”
At my words, Yuki-chan and the others struck a pose and let out a cry.
“GUA!”
“Wait, what!?”
Yuki-chan and the others each hoisted Father and his companions onto their backs, despite their heavy armor.
“Whoa! What the hell!? My hands are tangled in feathers!”
“Damn… I can’t break free! Motoyasu, what are you trying to pull!?”
“What exactly are you planning to do!?”
“Power leveling, of course.”
“I knew this was coming, but wasn’t it supposed to be tomorrow!?”
“Just bear with it for a bit. Even a small level boost should make things a little easier for you.”
In the meantime, I should go buy some ore to upgrade their gear. Even low-level weapons can be pretty effective if properly enhanced.
“Alright, off you go.”
“GUA!”
“Whoa! Too fast, too fast!”
“Where exactly are we going for two hours in this sticky mess—”
“Wait—ahhh—stop—!”
Father and the others were carried off on the backs of Yuki-chan and the others, dashing into the night. …For some reason, Father seemed to be enjoying himself.
“Aaaaah… the heroes…”
“Alright, let’s use this time to sell off these goods and buy some affordable ore for their upgrades.”
“R-right!”

Two hours should be plenty. That alone will be enough for them to feel the difference. Yuki-chan and the others may be level 40, but in reality, their strength is more like level 60. We’ll all just keep growing stronger together.
